'''2011 German National Championship Benjamin Jakob LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Benjamin Jakob]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
